SK9022 No binary log could be read

The binlog load mode had nothing to read: no --binlog was given and none of the conventional paths exists, the named file does not exist, the SDK's MSBuild could not be located to read it, or the log itself would not open. Run dotnet build -bl:artifacts/skala.binlog, or pass --binlog <path>. Under --load=auto the load falls back to workspace and then loose, announced by SK9025.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.6

Why

A binlog is the one load mode that reads what a build actually compiled — analyzer paths, generated sources, defines — so it is tried first, and its absence is worth a line rather than a silent fall-through into a mode that reads less. The detail lists the conventional paths that were searched (artifacts/skala.binlog, artifacts/build.binlog, artifacts/msbuild.binlog, msbuild.binlog, build.binlog), taken from the same array the search uses so the printed list cannot diverge from the searched one.

When it does not fire

Warning, and never fatal on its own: --require-fresh-binlog refuses only on error-severity load diagnostics, so this one does not trip it, and only when fallback is disabled does the empty load exit 4. One Csc invocation whose command line will not parse is reported under this id against its project and skipped, while the rest of the log still loads.
